title: Satan's Soldiers
wikitext:
A temporary clan formed for the Polish 4on4 league [[ClanWarz Poland]].

== History ==
After the Viper Squad decided not to join Clanwarz, Milton gathered a group of good players to be able to play in the league and not to make it too easy for [[Fusion]] and [[Slackers]].
